video_goal: Install a Hunter 52-inch Dempsey Low Profile ceiling fan in a living room.
required_subjects_and_props: Hunter 52-inch Dempsey Low Profile fan kit, Phillips screwdriver, power drill, wire nuts, step ladder, living room ceiling junction box, Hunter remote control.

outline_steps.visual_action: Hands open the Hunter Dempsey box on a living room floor, pulling out the low-profile motor housing and 52-inch wooden blades.
Hands use a power drill to drive two screws through the circular metal mounting bracket into the living room ceiling junction box.
Hands lift the heavy Hunter motor housing and hook its side slot onto the safety tab of the ceiling bracket to hold it in place.
Hands twist yellow wire nuts to connect the black and white wires from the ceiling to the fan's wiring harness.
Hands lift the motor housing flush against the ceiling bracket, inserting and tightening four screws into the side holes with a screwdriver.
On a table, hands align a 52-inch wooden fan blade with a metal blade iron, driving three screws in with a Phillips screwdriver.
Hands guide the assembled blade iron through the side slot of the mounted motor housing and tighten the captive screws.
Hands rotate the motor and attach the remaining three 52-inch blades, securing each with the screwdriver.
Hands snap the blue and white plastic wire plug connectors together, linking the motor to the light kit assembly.
Hands push the circular light kit pan up to the motor base and twist it clockwise to lock it into the keyhole slots.
Hands screw two LED bulbs into the threaded sockets of the attached light kit.
Hands lift the white glass globe, press it flush into the light kit housing, and twist clockwise until it locks.
A hand presses the power button on the Hunter remote control, and the fully assembled 52-inch Dempsey fan begins to spin in the living room.
